name: AECi — Data quality job failed (daily cron)
message:
The daily §23.1 data-quality job reported a failure in the last day (AECI-241 / Phase 7.6, 04:00 UTC cron). This fires when the job-level `aeci.data_quality.job{outcome:failed}` heartbeat is non-zero — either a check threw (captured per-check; the run still emits the rest) or a pre-run crash (e.g. DB binding down) took the inline catch in scheduled.ts. Pivot the per-check gauge `aeci.data_quality.check` by `check:` to see which check errored (an errored check reports the sentinel value -1), and read the `source:data-quality-cron` logs (`aeci.data_quality.check <id>` with `reason`, or `aeci.data_quality.crashed`) for the cause. The job is report-only — humans triage; nothing auto-repairs.

Note: this monitor deliberately does NOT use notify_no_data — `outcome:failed` is absent on a healthy run, so no-data here would be a constant false alarm. Cron liveness ('did the daily job run at all?') is the companion monitor 'AECi — Data quality job not running'.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#data-quality-job-failed-or-not-running
